No changeset. (2) `docs/adr-session-notifies-checker` (trail 167, https://entire.com/gh/orin-dx/-/trails/167): now that #300 merged (a session drops all cached checker answers on every published revision; SemanticHook::invalidate; answers in flight are not stored; see crates/core/src/pipeline/semantic_hook.rs and docs/type-checker-integration.md as merged), add dated status notes to ADR 0006 and ADR 0007 where they say 'must notify the checker of dependency edits with a parity test' stating what is implemented (clear-all invalidation on every revision, three tests) versus what is still a future refinement (per-component invalidation via Dependencies, parity test against extract()), following docs/adr/README.md conventions (status notes, not rewrites); verify every claim against the code. `just lint doc-check typos`, oxfmt on markdown.
